description.value: Cedar Root Gallery is the only 100% First Nations owned and operated retail store in Vancouver, operating since 1993 and located inside the Vancouver Aboriginal Friendship Centre. Founded by Mona Moreno of the Haida Nation, it specializes in authentic Northwest Coast artwork including hand-carved silver and gold jewellery, sacred masks, wall plaques, talking sticks, traditional medicines, and other Indigenous gift items. Shopping here directly supports Indigenous artists and fulfills Truth and Reconciliation Call to Action #92.

The OSM record lists the community as North Vancouver, but the website clearly places the gallery at 1607 East Hastings Street in Vancouver proper — a significant geographic discrepancy.
